lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Afghanistan to classify acute food insecurity conditions using standardized classification frameworks. The resulting dataset documents food insecurity phases and affected population counts across different scenarios, representing post-assessment impact data for drought-affected populations.
